description: A clipping plan for the user's size: only the campaigns that can actually pay a clip with their views (most campaigns pay nothing under a floor: a $10 minimum payout at $1 per 1K views pays nothing under 10,000 views, and pools pay nothing until your clips pass a total-views bar). For each: what a typical clip of theirs is likely to earn, the floor in plain words, the best moments to clip right now from that streamer's stream (with why chat reacted and hooks), the campaign's rule checklist (game, length, tags, disclosure, anything unread marked 'check the brief'), a ready caption with the required tags, and the exact cut_clip arguments and an editor link for each moment. Answers 'what should I clip today', 'which campaign can I actually earn from', 'I get about 800 views a clip, what pays', 'plan my clips for kaicenat'. views_per_clip (or account_size) sets the user's size; streamers and platforms narrow the plan. Never cuts or posts anything. Takes 5-25 seconds the first time a stream is read.

account_size.description: If they do not give a number: new = a new account, about 500 views a clip (default); 5k = about 5,000; 50k = about 50,000

platforms.description: Where they post. Leave out for any.

streamers.description: Streamers they clip: Twitch names or links, or kick.com/<name>. Leave out to consider every streamer a live campaign pays for.

views_per_clip.description: The user's typical views per clip, if they say it. Overrides account_size.

name: plan_my_clips
title: Plan my clips: which campaigns pay at my size, what to clip, the rules and a caption
